full_name: Chris Csikszentmihályi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Chris Csikszentmihályi is the Muriel Cooper Associate Professor of Media Arts and Sciences and directs the Computing Culture Group at the MIT Media Lab.
